trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Follow the roadmap in this guide: finish the story first, clear the side strands and activities, then grind the long-tail counts, with A Long Road / 100% as the final stretch — the cited guides put the whole platinum at roughly 200 hours. Source: Exophase / HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play through the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission, so this trophy pops early in a normal playthrough with nothing special to do. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Keep playing the story until Chapter 1 is finished; the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Before you leave Chapter 1, stop at Lucia's balcony meditation spot — it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is the one trophy reported as possibly missable. Source: Exophase / OutputLag.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy pops at the chapter's end. No side content is needed for it — just keep following the story beats. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Work through Chapter 3's missions in order until the chapter wraps up. Like the other chapter trophies it cannot be missed, since the story has to be completed anyway. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4 and the trophy unlocks at its conclusion. By this point the endgame is close, so it is a good moment to check which side strands and activities are still open before the finale. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission to earn the game's only hidden gold trophy. Make a manual save before starting it, as several guides recommend keeping one before the finale in case anything from earlier chapters still needs attention. Source: Exophase / OutputLag.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. It unlocks as part of the main story, so just keep playing the campaign and it will come. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play through The Cartel Heist mission to the end. It is a set-piece story mission, so follow its objectives and the trophy pops when it is done. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the Child's Play story mission. Nothing outside the mission itself is required — complete it and the trophy is yours. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners story mission. Keep pushing the main story and this one unlocks on its own. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the VCIA Takedown mission in the story. The airport setting ties into the VCIA area, so if you are chasing other airport-related trophies, remember the location for later. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory story mission. It is one of the later story missions, so it arrives naturally as you approach the finale. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion, which the in-game checklist tracks after the story credits. The 100% list asks for 70 of the 80 challenges, among other requirements, so this is the long tail of the platinum and the last gold most players earn. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunts build up naturally from jumps, near misses and airtime while driving, so treat this as a background grind and check the counter now and then rather than farming it in one sitting. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once — fishing, bowling, the arcade, drone racing, the shooting range, racing, meditation and the rest of the leisure options count toward the set. Do one of each early so you learn which activities you enjoy and which you will grind later. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Work through the range's challenge list one weapon at a time, and repeat a challenge until the gold threshold is met — accuracy and speed both matter, so slow down on the tight targets. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own race, so visit every drone-race spot on the map and take first place at each one. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each distinct race event counts once, so repeating the same race does not help. Mix car, bike and other race types and work through the map's race markers one by one. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Head to a fishing spot, take the challenge against Cal and out-fish him — the opening mission Gone Fishing teaches the basics, so use what it showed you. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game at an arcade machine. Any game counts, so pick the one you find easiest and play it through to the end. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Work through Andy's mission strand until his final mission, then complete it. Side strands open as you explore Leonida, so check the map for Andy's markers whenever they appear and do not leave his last mission hanging. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's strand by completing his final mission. Like the other character strands, it is a chain of missions — follow each one as it unlocks until the last is done. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission to close out his strand. Keep an eye on Billy's map markers between story missions so his chain does not stall. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as markers around the map — talk to them, finish their chains, and count your completed strands; the named character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and others) feed into this total. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand with his final mission. Do his missions as they appear and the trophy pops when the chain ends. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission to finish his strand. Tyrone is one of the stranger contacts, so his chain opens through his map markers — follow them to the end. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. WARNING — possibly missable: Lucia's balcony meditation spot in Chapter 1 counts toward this trophy and disappears after that chapter, and there is no mission replay, so meditate there before Chapter 1 ends. Keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one before the final mission, as the guides advise. Source: OutputLag / HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting work when it appears, track the animal he names, and bring it down — approach quietly and use a weapon suited to the hunt. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets by finding the cards scattered around Leonida. Collect every card you spot as you explore, and trade or track duplicates so each set fills up — three full sets earns the silver. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 locations across the state. This is a long exploration grind — do it steadily as you travel for other trophies, and keep a mental note of areas you have already covered so you are not revisiting the same spots. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 challenges in the game. Challenges span combat, driving, exploration and activities, so pick the easiest ones first and let the total climb while you chase other trophies — 70 are needed later for 100%, so this is a stepping stone. Source: HowToVideoGame.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then lose the cops and escape. Get out of the search area, break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear — doing it with your partner alongside is what counts. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them in quick succession, and keep the wanted level alive between robberies — if it drops to zero, start the chain again. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Just drive or ride anything new you see — each new model adds to the count, so vary your rides and grab unfamiliar vehicles whenever they appear on the road. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a fight with a group of enemies, trigger Combat Focus when several are in view, and drop five before it ends — a busy shootout gives you the best odds. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, the Vice City airport. Get to the airfield, take a plane and leave without following the usual departure routine — the trophy's wording points to an improvised exit rather than a normal flight. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Get involved with Rhinos — the tanks — and survive the heat they bring. The description hints at a tank encounter, so expect heavy resistance and come prepared with strong weapons and a fast escape route. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid cameras and staff sightlines, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm — if you are spotted, back out and try again. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs are bigger than shop robberies, so plan your exit before you go in and lose the wanted level after every vault — five clean escapes earns the silver. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, force it open, grab the cash and break away before the police close in — a fast getaway car makes the escape much easier. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — every region of the map, from Vice City to the rural corners of the state. Drive, fly and walk through areas you have not visited yet, and use the map to spot blank patches still waiting to be covered. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own operations, so you will need to find and hit one per gang — work through them as you learn where each gang operates. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The unlock method for this trophy is unconfirmed at launch — no guide has verified how it triggers yet. All the official description says is to enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so that is the only confirmed detail. Source: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The unlock method for this trophy is unconfirmed at launch — no guide has verified how it triggers yet. All the official description says is to smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style, so that is the only confirmed detail. Source: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl a game with a proper follow-through. It is a bowling activity, so play a full game at that alley and the trophy should follow. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the description points to a duo moment that resonates widely. This one is tied to the story's partnership thread, so keep playing with your partner and it should surface as the relationship develops. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices that affect your Criminal Profile — the tracker counts these actions up to 500. Every decision you make in the world feeds the count, so play naturally and make choices as they come rather than trying to farm a single action. Source: u7buy.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The unlock method for this trophy is unconfirmed at launch — no guide has verified how it triggers yet. All the official description says is 'Second time's the charm', so that is the only confirmed detail. Source: OutputLag.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The unlock method for this trophy is unconfirmed at launch — no guide has verified how it triggers yet. All the official description says is 'What the hell just happened?', so that is the only confirmed detail. Source: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The unlock method for this trophy is unconfirmed at launch — no guide has verified how it triggers yet. All the official description says is to bowl them over with a melee drive-by, so that is the only confirmed detail. Source: OutputLag.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering marked bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from robberies and heists, so keep feeding them to your contacts until the total hits $250,000 — it builds up alongside the robbery trophies. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida. Buy weapons, clothes, vehicles and upgrades as you play and the total climbs on its own — if you are close near the end, spend the remainder on expensive gear. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties in Leonida. Garages go on sale as you explore, so buy each one when it appears and keep the money flowing — they also give you somewhere to store the vehicles you are collecting. Source: Exophase.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around the city, open the app and register each one — ten registrations earns the trophy, so do it whenever you spot a ride you have not logged yet. Source: Exophase.
